control.description-key: Compact 3-field control for tracking flags (v1.0.22). Combines two Yes/No toggles (Monitor, High Priority) with a 3-value segmented picker (Access Permission), plus an opt-in governance toolbar (grant-access modal + email-members icons). The grant modal is polymorphic across Project/Matter/Work Assignment and uses the side-pane Advanced Lookup for the contact + organization pickers. Designed to fit inside a 33% form column.

property.name: monitor
property.description-key: Bound Two-Option field for the Monitor flag

property.name: highPriority
property.description-key: Bound Two-Option field for the High Priority flag

property.name: accessPermission
property.description-key: Bound OptionSet field with three values: Standard (100000000), Limited (100000001), Restricted (100000002)

property.name: title
property.description-key: Optional header title shown on the left of the control header row (14px semibold). The grant/email icons always sit at the right of that row. Leave blank for an icons-only header.

property.name: showTitle
property.description-key: Show the field caption labels (Monitor, High Priority, Access Permission) above each control. When hidden, the row moves up. Default: visible.

property.name: showVersion
property.description-key: Show the version badge in the bottom-right corner. Default: hidden.

property.name: apiBaseUrl
property.description-key: BFF API base URL used by the access-grant modal (task 041)

property.name: clientAppId
property.description-key: Azure AD application (client) ID for PCF MSAL authentication

property.name: bffAppId
property.description-key: BFF API application ID for OAuth scope construction
